Jules (People Ops): Heads up team — Tom's start is Monday but our SF office is closed due to localized flooding. He was scheduled for in-person I-9 Section 2 / badge pickup. Need an exception plan.

Priya (HR): Policy: if office inaccessible, we can do remote I-9 verification using a live recorded video + notarized affidavit OR schedule a 7-day post-start in-person verification at first available site. For equipment, IT can hold shipment 48-72hrs.

Tom (New Hire): I can do a recorded video tonight and get an e-notary tomorrow morning. I have driver's license + SS card scanned. Also curious about benefits start date — do I enroll now?

Priya (HR): Please complete the alternate-intake form: https://forms.redwood.com/i9-remote-exception and pick "recorded-video + e-notary". Benefits can be enrolled but we'll mark enrollment effective date contingent on verification timestamp — typically retro to your start if verified within 14 days.

Jules (People Ops): Add note: if e-notary not available in your state, we accept state DMV certified copy + recorded video + couriered certified copy within 7 days.

Alex (IT): Laptop: I can ship next-day but will set the courier to hold signature until we get green from Jules. VPN/SSO off until I-9 cleared. If Tom wants temporary cloud-only access I can provision today.

Maya (Payroll): Quick payroll tax note: your W-4 e-sign failed earlier because your SSN entry had dashes. Re-submit without dashes (e.g., 123456789). Also confirm mailing address for W-2 — international-format addresses occasionally trip the payroll validator.

BG-Bot: Background check case BG-11207 updated: awaiting ID documents.

Tom (New Hire): Done with the form and uploaded scans (link: https://files.redwood.com/upload/TOM-IMG). Booked e-notary slot for 10:00am PST tomorrow. I'll remove dashes and re-submit W-4.

Priya (HR): Attestation script for the recorded video (copy/paste into the recording):

"I, [Full Name], attest that the driver's license and Social Security card shown in this recording are mine. I consent to Redwood Inference recording and retaining this verification for onboarding and I-9 purposes."

Jules (People Ops): Plan: 1) Tom records tonight + completes e-notary tomorrow, 2) HR logs exception and marks provisional access, 3) Payroll gets corrected W-4, 4) IT ships laptop after JR approves. Benefits tentative start date aligned pending verification (usually retro). I'll confirm when recording uploaded. :white_check_mark:

Alex (IT): Provisioned cloud account and email. Holding physical device. Ping me when green to release.

Maya (Payroll): Once W-4 accepted I'll queue payroll setup. If verification completes within 14 days benefits retro-pay will be processed in next payroll cycle.

Tom (New Hire): Uploaded recording and e-notary confirmation. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

Jules (People Ops): Received — updating BG case and Onboarding Exceptions sheet: tag `office-closure-flooding-remote-i9`. Closing loop after payroll confirms W-4 accepted.

BG-Bot: BG-11207 status -> documents-received.
